title.narrative: PROGRAMA DE RECALIFICACIN URBANA DE LA REGIN OESTE DE ARACAJU CONSTRUYENDO PARA EL FUTURO
URBAN UPGRADE PROGRAM IN THE WESTERN AREA OF ARACAJU BUILDING FOR THE FUTURE

description.narrative: El objetivo general es promover el mejoramiento del espacio urbano de Aracaju. Losobjetivos especficos son: (i) aumentar el acceso a la infraestructura urbana, vivienda y servicios sociales de la poblacin de laszonas norte y oeste; (ii) reducir el tiempo de viaje entre los barrios; y (iii) incrementar la cantidad de reas verdes y protegidasdel municipio.

The general objective is to help upgrade the urban spaces in Aracaju. The specific objectives are to: (i) improve access to urban infrastructure, housing, and social services for the population in the northern and western areas; (ii) reduce travel time between neighborhoods; and (iii) increase the number of green and protected spaces in the municpio.
